source.use: the idea that an outcome-only score hides whether agents introduced, amplified, attenuated or corrected an error on the way

declared_rule.hop_error: e_k = |message_k - reference_k|; p = e_(k-1), with p = 0 for the first hop

classes.amplified: p > tol and e >= p (equal magnitude is amplified: not reduced)
classes.attenuated: p > tol and tol < e < p

declared_rule.tolerance_edge: an error exactly equal to the tolerance is within it
declared_rule.trace: reached_end if the final error > tol; corrected if some hop error > tol and the final error <= tol; clean otherwise
declared_rule.arm_a: PASS iff the final error <= tol
declared_rule.numbers: exact decimals: <= 32 characters, |value| <= 1000000 by copy_abs, <= 12 decimal places, no positive exponent, NaN/Infinity bad_number, bool bad_type, -0 read as 0; steps exact at 700 significant digits with Inexact trapped (DENY computed_out_of_range); computed |value| > 1E+15 is DENY computed_out_of_range; a computed -0 is reported as 0

measured.note: counts of hand-made planted chains, not rates

on_unmeasured.what: author-reported: the paper's structural model reaches a mean condition-level Spearman correlation of 0.84 across base models, against 0.47 for direct regression
author-reported: model-guided retrieval improves accuracy over no retrieval by an average of 19 percentage points with 16% additional tokens
author-reported scope: three Qwen base models, six multi-agent workflows and ten knowledge and reasoning settings in the paper's benchmark
the paper's structural model (separate input assembly and agent processing across error channels) is not implemented; agents here are fixed arithmetic steps
any LLM agent, real workflow or benchmark data; all chains are synthetic
